title: 股票价格波动
summary: 维护时间戳价格并允许更正，查询最新时间价格、当前最高价与最低价。
insight: 哈希表保存时间到价格；有序频次表保存所有当前价格。更正时先减少旧价格频次再加入新价格，最新时间取最大时间戳。
pitfalls: update 可覆盖已有时间戳
current 按最大时间戳而非最近调用

solutions.title: 时间映射与价格有序多重集
solutions.idea: 同步维护最新时间与可取首尾价格的频次树。
steps: update：若时间已有则移除旧价格一次；写新价并增加频次，更新 latestTime
current 查最新时间；maximum lastKey；minimum firstKey

complexity.time: O(log n) 每次更新/极值查询

code.java: class StockPrice { Map<Integer,Integer> prices=new HashMap<>();TreeMap<Integer,Integer> counts=new TreeMap<>();int latest=0;public StockPrice(){}public void update(int timestamp,int price){if(prices.containsKey(timestamp)){int old=prices.get(timestamp);counts.put(old,counts.get(old)-1);if(counts.get(old)==0)counts.remove(old);}prices.put(timestamp,price);counts.merge(price,1,Integer::sum);latest=Math.max(latest,timestamp);}public int current(){return prices.get(latest);}public int maximum(){return counts.lastKey();}public int minimum(){return counts.firstKey();} }
code.kotlin: class StockPrice { private val prices=HashMap<Int,Int>();private val counts=java.util.TreeMap<Int,Int>();private var latest=0;fun update(timestamp:Int,price:Int){prices[timestamp]?.let{old->counts[old]=counts[old]!!-1;if(counts[old]==0)counts.remove(old)};prices[timestamp]=price;counts[price]=(counts[price]?:0)+1;latest=maxOf(latest,timestamp)}fun current()=prices[latest]!!;fun maximum()=counts.lastKey();fun minimum()=counts.firstKey()}
code.cpp: class StockPrice { unordered_map<int,int> prices;map<int,int> counts;int latest=0;public: StockPrice(){}void update(int timestamp,int price){if(prices.count(timestamp)){int old=prices[timestamp];if(!--counts[old])counts.erase(old);}prices[timestamp]=price;++counts[price];latest=max(latest,timestamp);}int current(){return prices[latest];}int maximum(){return counts.rbegin()->first;}int minimum(){return counts.begin()->first;} };
